integrity: Analytical proof of global curvature/unimodality with a separate numerical illustrative check; no independent validation or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Counts strictly positive fixed points of the two-dimensional deterministic normalized map; no stability, persistence, or oscillatory-dynamics theorem. The fold is an algebraic equilibrium branch statement. The 2021 related full paper was not available for complete comparison.
title: Sharp coexistence-equilibrium census for a refuge-and-cooperation Ricker map
